description: This PHP source file defines the 'Archive' class within the 'ZipStream\Option' namespace. It provides configuration options for creating ZIP archives, including compression settings, HTTP headers, and stream management.

classes.name: Archive
classes.description: A class encapsulating options and settings for ZIP archive creation and streaming, including file size limits, compression methods, HTTP headers, and output stream configuration.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment string associated with the archive.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment string for the archive.

methods.name: getLargeFileSize
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum size (bytes) of files to be loaded into memory.

methods.name: setLargeFileSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size (bytes) of files to load into memory.

methods.name: getLargeFileMethod
methods.description: Returns the method used for handling large files (e.g., STORE or DEFLATE).

methods.name: setLargeFileMethod
methods.description: Sets the method to handle large files in the archive.

methods.name: isSendHttpHeaders
methods.description: Checks whether HTTP headers are to be sent.

methods.name: setSendHttpHeaders
methods.description: Enables or disables sending of HTTP headers.

methods.name: getHttpHeaderCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the callback function used to send HTTP headers.

methods.name: setHttpHeaderCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function for sending HTTP headers.

methods.name: isEnableZip64
methods.description: Checks if ZIP64 extension support is enabled.

methods.name: setEnableZip64
methods.description: Enables or disables ZIP64 extension support.

methods.name: isZeroHeader
methods.description: Checks if streaming files with zero header is enabled.

methods.name: setZeroHeader
methods.description: Enables or disables zero header streaming.

methods.name: isFlushOutput
methods.description: Checks if output stream flushing after each write is enabled.

methods.name: setFlushOutput
methods.description: Enables or disables flushing output stream after each write.

methods.name: isStatFiles
methods.description: Checks if file stat reading for size determination is enabled.

methods.name: setStatFiles
methods.description: Enables or disables reading file stat for size determination.

methods.name: getContentDisposition
methods.description: Gets the Content-Disposition header value.

methods.name: setContentDisposition
methods.description: Sets the Content-Disposition header value.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Gets the Content-Type header value.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the Content-Type header value.

methods.name: getOutputStream
methods.description: Retrieves the current output stream or resource.

methods.name: setOutputStream
methods.description: Sets the output stream or resource.

methods.name: getDeflateLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the level of deflate compression.

methods.name: setDeflateLevel
methods.description: Sets the level of deflate compression.
